title: "X_spiracleAnalysis"
output: html_document
---

# Load libraries

```{r}
# Load tidyverse
library(tidyverse)

# Load broom
library(broom)

# Load marginaleffects
library(marginaleffects)

# Load patchwork for plotting
library(patchwork)
```

# Load data

```{r}
# Load csv
rayData <- read.csv("Data/Data_Tidy/allMuseumRayData.csv")
```

# Prepare data for analysis

```{r}
logData <- rayData %>%
  mutate(logSA = log10(SpiracleArea),
         # Convert Spiracle Length (SPL) to cm and log10
         SPL_cm = SpiracleLength / 10,
         logSPL = log10(SPL_cm)) %>%
  # Drop rows with NAs
  drop_na(logSA, logSPL) %>%
  # Remove species with less than 4 individuals
  group_by(Genus_species) %>%
  filter(n() > 3) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Run linear model

```{r}
# Run linear model
model <- lm(logSA ~  logSPL * Genus_species, data = logData)
# Show model summary
summary(model)

# Convert summary to a df
model_sum <- tidy(model)
# Export to csv
write.csv(model_sum, file = "Results/Tables/SPL_SA.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# Generate predicted data

```{r}
# Generate predicted data for smooth lines
spiraclePred <- logData %>%
  group_by(Genus_species) %>%
  reframe(logSPL = seq(min(logSPL), max(logSPL), length.out = 100))
# Add model predicted values to data frame
spiraclePred$predictedSA <- predict(model, newdata = spiraclePred)
```

# Plot

```{r}
allPlot <- ggplot(data = logData, aes(x = logSPL, y = logSA)) +
  geom_line(data = spiraclePred,
            aes(x = logSPL, y = predictedSA, group = Genus_species),
            linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) format(round(10^x, 1))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(y) format(round(10^y, 1))) +
  labs(x = "Spiracle Length (cm)",
       y = expression("Spiracle Surface Area (" * cm^2 * ")")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

allPlot

facetPlot <- ggplot(data = logData, aes(x = logSPL, y = logSA)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(data = spiraclePred,
            aes(x = logSPL, y = predictedSA, group = Genus_species),
            linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) 10^x) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(y) 10^y) +
  facet_wrap(~ Genus_species, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Spiracle Length (cm)",
       y = expression("Spiracle Surface Area ( " * cm^2 * ")")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "italic"),
        strip.background = element_blank())

facetPlot

ggsave("Results/Figures/SPL_SA.png", allPlot,
       width = 10, height = 10)
```

# Supplementary?

```{r}
# Differences in slope between species (compared to ref. species)
# Extract 95% confidence intervals
tidyModel <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95) %>% 
  # Retain interaction rows
  filter(str_detect(term, "logSPL:")) %>%
  mutate(
  # Clean up species names
  Group = str_remove(term, "logSPL:Genus_species"),
  Group = str_replace_all(Group, "_", " "),
  # TRUE if 0 is NOT between the lower and upper bounds
  significant = !(conf.low <= 0 & conf.high >= 0))
# Plot the coefficients
ggplot(tidyModel, aes(x = estimate, y = reorder(Group, estimate), 
                      color = significant)) +
  # Reference line
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  # Plot error bars for each species
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), 
                 width = 0) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "darkslategray3", 
                                "FALSE" = "darkslategray")) +
  labs(x = "Difference in Coefficient Estimate",
       y = "") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, face = "italic"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8))

# Differences in slope within species (compared to 0)
# Get slopes and create the color variable
slopes <- slopes(model, variables = "logSPL", by = "Genus_species") %>% 
  mutate(
    # TRUE if 0 is NOT between the lower and upper bounds
    significant = !(conf.low <= 0 & conf.high >= 0),
    Genus_species = str_replace_all(Genus_species, "_", " "))
# Plot
ggplot(slopes, aes(x = estimate, y = reorder(Genus_species, estimate), 
                   color = significant)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), 
                 width = 0) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "darkslategray3", 
                                "FALSE" = "darkslategray")) +
  labs(x = "",
       y = "") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, face = "italic"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8))
```
